name: Link safety check
summary: Phishing signals and tracking clean-up for a link
author: friday-core
description: Reads a link and judges it; never opens it. It holds 2 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Link risk check: Reads a link and looks for phishing signals: name@host tricks, bare IP hosts, punycode look-alikes, link shorteners, odd domain endings, famous brand names on someone else's domain and login or verify wording. It never opens the link. URL cleaner: Rewrites links for sharing and checking: removes tracking parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid and similar), unwraps known redirect wrappers (Google, Facebook, Outlook safelinks, Reddit, YouTube) and flags look-alike tricks: user@ in the address, punycode hosts, bare IP addresses, link shorteners, plain http. It only rewrites text; it never opens the link.
